summary: Initialization constructor for a media stream/playback object (called only by ObjectConstructor_6f76, 0x00516F76). Captures the sub-object at this+0x17C and its control flags, initializes the identity-pattern buffer, then follows the enable flag v3 (this+0x4A): when clear (or this+0x40 clear) it zeroes the three state flags 0x58/0x59/0x5A. When v3 is set it runs the state-machine branch keyed on this+0x64==3: flag 0x59 is raised when this+0x74 holds a value, flag 0x5A when this+0x50 does, otherwise both are cleared and this+0x74 reset; flag 0x58 is then set, and ObjectSetupWithBoundsCheck + sub_51E0DC run under their respective flag guards, copying this+0x1A4 into the sub-object fields 0x14/0x18. When this+0x41 is clear it configures either the stream decoder (sub-object v1+0x10 set) or input bindings + audio decode dispatch, then allocates the playback buffer. It allocates the UI combo-box buffer, dispatches the Huffman tree/context allocation by flags 0xC9/0xC8, builds the UI combo box with mode v8 computed from the this+0x18C sub-object flag and this+0x40, allocates the media buffer, calls the virtual method at slot +0x18 of the this+0x4 sub-object and slot +8 of the this+0x18C sub-object (whose result is returned), and finally, when the this+0x8 sub-object is present and the stream flag set, sizes its buffer as v6*(this+0x118) and bumps the completion counter at v1+0xC.
